title: Marguerite and the Terminal
author: Paloma Yarrow
blurb: Yara Amberdale, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
